data.value: What strict mode does not resist

data.name: StrictLimitsBody
data.value:
Strict mode is a deliberate gate, not authentication. It resists closing the UI, a normal restart, clock changes, basic configuration edits, temporarily disabling the extension, and renaming or copying executables where a hash rule exists.
It does not resist a determined administrator, Safe Mode, editing the data offline from another operating system, or any tampering outside the threat model.
